question: Should Hermit adopt the pinned canonical OpenClaw pull request template exactly as submitted?
rationale: The patch is technically clean, but repository-member work requires explicit human handling and adoption of repository contribution policy is ultimately an owner decision.

options.title: Adopt canonical template
options.body: Merge the exact pinned template to standardize contribution evidence across OpenClaw repositories.

options.title: Request Hermit-specific adjustments
options.body: Keep the shared section structure but ask for narrowly documented repository-specific wording before merge.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical template
recommendation.body: Merge the exact pinned template to standardize contribution evidence across OpenClaw repositories.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member contributor coordinating this pinned cross-repository maintenance update and can confirm its intended policy scope.
